apppress/airtable-connector.name: Airtable Connector
apppress/airtable-connector.description: Connect Airtable bases for schema-flexible record read/search/create/update and workflow automation on record changes.
apppress/airtable-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/asana-connector.name: Asana Connector
apppress/asana-connector.description: Production Asana connector for CampusLaunch — find/create/update tasks, read projects and sections, and inbound workflow triggers for task-created and task-completed events via Asana's signed webhook handshake.
apppress/asana-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/billing.name: AppPress Billing
apppress/billing.description: Stripe-powered subscription billing with plans, feature quotas, usage tracking, customer portal, and webhook sync. Implements StandardContracts::BILLING and emits eight outbound workflow triggers (subscription_created, subscription_cancelled, subscription_renewed, payment_failed, payment_succeeded, plan_changed, trial_started, trial_ended). Provides workflow actions for sending payment links, cancelling subscriptions, checking subscription status, assigning plans, and recording usage. Exposes connector query surfaces for subscriptions, invoices, and feature usage.
apppress/billing.author: AppPress

apppress/documents.name: AppPress Documents
apppress/documents.description: HTML templating and PDF generation for workflows and business records. Implements StandardContracts::DOCUMENTS and core.generate_pdf workflow action.
apppress/documents.author: AppPress

apppress/docusign-connector.name: DocuSign Connector
apppress/docusign-connector.description: Production DocuSign eSignature connector for CampusLaunch — send envelopes for signature from templates, track envelope and recipient status, list/search envelopes, void envelopes, and inbound Connect webhook triggers for envelope-completed and recipient-completed events.
apppress/docusign-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/dropbox-connector.name: Dropbox Connector
apppress/dropbox-connector.description: Production Dropbox connector for AppPress — find/upload/move files and folders, short-lived download links instead of embedded file bytes, and an inbound workflow trigger for file changes driven by Dropbox's real notification-only webhook (list_folder/continue delta discovery), with the GET challenge-echo handshake required for subscription registration.
apppress/dropbox-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/forms.name: AppPress Forms
apppress/forms.description: Drag-and-drop form builder for public intake and operator-managed capture — submissions, email notifications, honeypot and rate-limit spam protection, optional anti-spam middleware, CSV export, workflow triggers, and mobile FormScreen embeds. Implements StandardContracts::FORMS.
apppress/forms.author: AppPress

apppress/freshdesk-connector.name: Freshdesk Connector
apppress/freshdesk-connector.description: Production Freshdesk support-desk connector for AppPress — create, update, and annotate tickets, list/search tickets, look up contacts and companies, and inbound webhook triggers for ticket-created and ticket-updated events.
apppress/freshdesk-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/github-connector.name: GitHub Connector
apppress/github-connector.description: Production GitHub connector for AppPress — find/create issues, comment on issues, and read repositories via workflow automation, with real issue/comment webhooks.
apppress/github-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/google-calendar-connector.name: Google Calendar Connector
apppress/google-calendar-connector.description: Production Google Calendar connector for CampusLaunch — event create/update/delete/get, calendar listing, free/busy availability lookups, search, and webhook triggers for event created/updated via Google's Calendar Watch push notifications.
apppress/google-calendar-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/gusto-connector.name: Gusto Connector
apppress/gusto-connector.description: Production Gusto connector for CampusLaunch — read/search employees, read compensation rates, and read payroll runs, scoped to a Gusto company (company UUID) via OAuth2. Highly sensitive HR/payroll data: no SSN or bank/direct-deposit fields are ever requested or exposed.
apppress/gusto-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/intercom-connector.name: Intercom Connector
apppress/intercom-connector.description: Production Intercom connector for AppPress — create, update, and look up contacts (leads/users), read and search conversations, post admin replies, and inbound webhook triggers for new conversations and new contacts.
apppress/intercom-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/jira-connector.name: Jira Connector
apppress/jira-connector.description: Production Jira Cloud connector for AppPress — find/create/update issues, read/search projects, and workflow automation on real Jira data.
apppress/jira-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/klaviyo-connector.name: Klaviyo Connector
apppress/klaviyo-connector.description: Connect Klaviyo for marketing profile/event management and workflow automation on list-subscribe and email-engagement events.
apppress/klaviyo-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/mailchimp-connector.name: Mailchimp Connector
apppress/mailchimp-connector.description: Connect Mailchimp for audience/subscriber management and workflow automation on member subscribe, unsubscribe, and profile-update events.
apppress/mailchimp-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/media.name: AppPress Media Processing
apppress/media.description: Image processing pipeline for the core media library: responsive variants, WebP conversion, EXIF stripping, metadata extraction, background queue processing, operator dashboard, and mobile gallery surfaces. Implements StandardContracts::MEDIA so App Packs and plugins can trigger processing without direct coupling.
apppress/media.author: AppPress

apppress/mixpanel-connector.name: Mixpanel Connector
apppress/mixpanel-connector.description: Mixpanel connector for AppPress — fire-and-forget event tracking via the real-time Track API, plus read/search of user profiles via the Query/Engage API (Service Account auth). Mixpanel's ingestion side is write-only, like Segment: there is no read/update/delete on tracked events because Mixpanel's real API does not expose one.
apppress/mixpanel-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/notifications.name: AppPress Notifications
apppress/notifications.description: Multi-channel notification center for AppPress — in-app bell, email, browser push (VAPID), SMS (Twilio), and Expo mobile push. Implements StandardContracts::NOTIFICATIONS so workflows and plugins deliver alerts without direct coupling.
apppress/notifications.author: AppPress

apppress/notion-connector.name: Notion Connector
apppress/notion-connector.description: Production Notion connector for AppPress — query, create, update, and read pages in a connected Notion database via workflow automation.
apppress/notion-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/pages.name: AppPress Pages
apppress/pages.description: Read-only CMS surfaces for AppPress Core's page system: shortcodes ([page], [page_menu]), a page-menu widget, block-editor embed blocks, a mobile RichTextScreen surface, an operator metrics dashboard, and workflow triggers/webhooks fired from core's real page lifecycle events. Does not own page storage or CRUD — page creation, editing, and revision history are core's canonical apppress/pages system (Admin -> Pages).
apppress/pages.author: AppPress

apppress/quickbooks-connector.name: QuickBooks Connector
apppress/quickbooks-connector.description: Production QuickBooks Online connector for CampusLaunch — create/update customers, create invoices, find/search customers, and an inbound webhook trigger for invoice-paid events, scoped to a QuickBooks company (realm) via OAuth2.
apppress/quickbooks-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/quote-portal.name: Quote & Estimate Portal
apppress/quote-portal.description: A complete business workflow for capturing leads, sending quotes, and getting paid. Replaces disjointed form and invoicing tools.
apppress/quote-portal.author: AppPress

apppress/salesforce-connector.name: Salesforce Connector
apppress/salesforce-connector.description: Connect Salesforce CRM for lead, contact, and opportunity sync plus workflow automation.
apppress/salesforce-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/segment-connector.name: Segment Connector
apppress/segment-connector.description: Write-only Segment Tracking API connector for AppPress — send track/identify events out to a Segment source from workflows. Segment is an event-ingestion endpoint, not a queryable data store: there is no read/search/update/delete operation because Segment's real API does not expose one.
apppress/segment-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/shopify-connector.name: Shopify Connector
apppress/shopify-connector.description: Production Shopify connector for AppPress — find/create/update customers and read orders via workflow automation, with real order webhooks.
apppress/shopify-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/slack-connector.name: Slack Connector
apppress/slack-connector.description: Connect Slack for channel lookup, message posting/editing, and workflow automation on inbound Slack events.
apppress/slack-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/squarespace-connector.name: Squarespace Connector
apppress/squarespace-connector.description: Production Squarespace connector for AppPress — find/create/update customers via the real Contacts API, read/search Commerce orders, and real order webhooks.
apppress/squarespace-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/trello-connector.name: Trello Connector
apppress/trello-connector.description: Production Trello connector for AppPress — find/create/update cards, read boards and lists, and workflow automation on real card-activity webhooks.
apppress/trello-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/twilio-connector.name: Twilio Connector
apppress/twilio-connector.description: Connect Twilio for SMS notifications, message lookup/redaction, and workflow automation on inbound SMS and delivery-status events.
apppress/twilio-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/typeform-connector.name: Typeform Connector
apppress/typeform-connector.description: Typeform connector for AppPress — inbound form-response webhook trigger plus read/search of forms and form responses via a Personal Access Token. Typeform's public API is response-ingestion-shaped: there is no create/update/delete operation for responses because form responses are end-user submissions, not something an API client writes.
apppress/typeform-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/workflows.name: AppPress Workflows
apppress/workflows.description: Visual automation engine for AppPress — trigger → conditions → actions. When X happens, do Y. Supports 19 built-in triggers, 13 built-in actions, HMAC-signed webhook ingress, approval gates, delayed steps, conditional branching, formula evaluation, version snapshots with rollback, multi-site scoping, and rate-limiting circuit breakers. Implements StandardContracts::WORKFLOWS so any App Pack can resolve the workflow service without a direct dependency.
apppress/workflows.author: AppPress

apppress/xero-connector.name: Xero Connector
apppress/xero-connector.description: Production Xero connector for CampusLaunch — create/update contacts, create invoices, find/search contacts, read payments, and inbound workflow triggers for invoice-created and invoice-paid events, scoped to a real Xero organisation (tenant) discovered via Xero's /connections API after OAuth2 connect.
apppress/xero-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/zendesk-connector.name: Zendesk Connector
apppress/zendesk-connector.description: Production Zendesk support-desk connector for CampusLaunch — create, update, and comment on tickets, list/search tickets and read users, and inbound webhook triggers for ticket-created and ticket-status-changed events.
apppress/zendesk-connector.author: AppPress
